input_text:
CONTRACT CONTEXT:
The Receiving Party: (d) shall not disclose to any person (other than those of its Representatives who are actively and directly participating in the Evaluation or who otherwise need to know for the purpose of the Evaluation) any information about the Evaluation, or the terms or conditions or any other facts relating thereto, including, without limitation, the fact that discussions are taking place with respect thereto or the status thereof, or the fact that Confidential Information has been made available to the Receiving Party or its Representatives.  

TARGET STATEMENT:
The contract entails that the relevant party must keep confidential the existence, terms, subject matter, or status of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or transaction between the parties.

DECISION TASK:
Determine whether the contract context entails the target statement.
